text:
Maya: Quick sync — Syndicate customer's ask landed. They want per-tenant KMS + HSM-backed keys and 99th %ile latency targets. Need cross-team alignment on scope and launch criteria.
Sam: Can you paste the customer ask? link or snippet?
Maya: Snippet: "support per-tenant KMS key + 99th %ile latency 150ms for text-gen at 2k tokens". They're willing to pay for dedicated capacity.
Alex: infra note: we can allocate a dedicated shard but HSM/KMS integration and audit logs add ~3w of infra work.
Jordan: security: HSM onboarding + attestation + SOC2 control mapping — estimate 2 sprints for compliance artifacts.
Sam: runtime: perf-wise 2k tokens at 150ms is tough on current model. We can hit it with smaller model variants + quantization + aggressive batching/timeout tuning. Needs runtime experiments. ~2 sprints.
Lee: Product asks: what's MVP for launch? can we ship with soft-SLA and plan for hard-SLA later?
Maya: Proposed MVP: per-tenant KMS optional (rollout to 10 customers), 95th percentile SLA 200ms, telemetry + evals. Hard SLA and HSM in beta.
Priya: Timeline ask from sales — customer wants pilot in 8 weeks. Is that realistic?
Sam: If we parallelize: runtime experiment (1 sprint) + infra prep + security docs in parallel (2 teams), we might make pilot if HSM is behind a feature flag and we use customer-managed KMS for pilot.
Jordan: We can't fake HSM for compliance claims. For pilot we can do 'customer-managed KMS' and limited audit logs; full HSM attestation needs the longer track. Need legal ok.
Maya: Action items: Maya -> get legal on customer-managed KMS by EOD Thurs; Alex -> infra plan + estimate by Mon; Sam -> runtime perf experiment checklist by Fri; Jordan -> compliance delta doc by Mon.
Alex: infra pre-reqs: network peering, dedicated GPU pool, KMS connector, audit logging. I'll put a PRD doc in /wiki and tag folks.
Sam: Runtime checklist snippet:
```
- baseline perf for model at 512/1024/2048
- quantization config A/B
- batching policy + p95/p99 latency monitoring
- KV cache warmup test
```
Maya: Can we get a real blocker list and owners by Monday standup? @Sam @Alex @Jordan @Priya
Priya: I'll own customer communication and scope negotiation. Will frame pilot = soft SLA + no HSM attestation; ask for dedicated capacity purchase.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: PROD-8241 "Syndicate pilot preflight" assigned to Alex.
Lee: +1 on pilot scope. Also propose run an eval harness to catch quality regressions tied to quantization — linking eval template: https://redwood.internal/evals/syndicate.
Sam: Ok I'll run evals and share results in #eng-runtime. If perf hit too high, we'll offer a smaller model for pilot and a migration path.
Maya: Thanks all. Weekly checkpoint same time next Tue. I'll record decisions in the initiative doc and ping owners if anything slips.
